reviews.text: I had my cat spayed at this vet's office in February 2026. I was very anxious, and he reassured me both on the phone and in person during our post-spaying appointment. My cat's stitches were very clean and well done; she didn't manage to pull them out, and the scar is practically invisible. I recommend this vet for his compassionate approach and also for his reasonable prices.

Excellent care for our cat, thank you! You can immediately tell he has a lot of experience. Dr. Brame is very reassuring, friendly, and a great communicator! We always get an appointment the same day or the next. He takes his time, and the basic consultation fee is very reasonable. We're so glad we found such a great vet! 🐾 …

Mr. Brame is welcoming and attentive.

Thank you. 👍🏻 …

Dr. Brame is a very good veterinarian. In my opinion, the best. He treated my dogs, and now he treats my large cat. He is always attentive and available.
I recommend this veterinarian 100%.
